candidates.statement: Redis reserve_inventory operations time out (~2s) on the inventory dependency, causing inventory /v1/reservations to return 503 and order /v1/orders to fail with ReadTimeout, surfacing as 502s at gateway /v1/checkout.
candidates.uncertainty: Traces show timeouts but no Redis-side metrics or logs to confirm whether the cause is saturation, latency, or connectivity.

report.explanation: Traces across multiple correlation IDs show redis.reserve_inventory timing out with DependencyUnavailable, inventory returning 503, order ReadTimeout, and gateway /v1/checkout returning 502. Metrics show 16 checkout 502s and p95 ~2425ms on /v1/checkout. Topology confirms inventory->redis. Bounded to redis-timeout.
